storyTitle: [Bank Portal][Product Setup] Manual Bank - Personal Loan - View details/Create/Edit a product
navigation: Login -> Product Setup -> Personal Loan tab -> Add Product / View / Pricing Matrix

testCases.precondition: Logged into Bank Portal on Product Setup > Personal Loan tab.
testCases.steps: Click Add Product and inspect labels and product-type tag.
testCases.expected: Add Product screen opens with label tag 'Product Type: Personal Loan', breadcrumb 'Product Setup' and the General Information section.

testCases.precondition: On the PL Add Product screen.
testCases.steps: Trigger blank/duplicate Product Name, blank Sub Type, min>max amounts, min>max tenor, negative Minimum Salary, invalid Age Limit.
testCases.expected: IEM003 on blank mandatory; IEM036 on duplicate name; IEM012 on min>max (amount/tenor/salary); Age Limit 01-99; tenor max 3 digits; Minimum Salary >=0 max 7 digits with CR001 formatting.

testCases.precondition: On the PL Add Product screen, Document Upload section.
testCases.steps: Upload wrong-format and >10MB files to Card Artifact, Terms and Conditions, Featured Promotion.
testCases.expected: All three boxes accept PDF only; wrong format -> IEM047; >10MB -> IEM031; valid uploads expose View and delete controls.

testCases.precondition: On the PL Add Product screen with all mandatory fields valid.
testCases.steps: Click Save and inspect the generated product code and status.
testCases.expected: Saves with Product Type = Personal Loan; auto-generated 13-char code with PL prefix (<BankCode>_PL_<UniqueID>); Status = Active; toast '[Product Name] added successfully!'; CR003 audit entry.

testCases.precondition: On PL Pricing Matrix Step 1 with rate fields visible.
testCases.steps: Enter rate values with 5 decimal places into Fixed Period Profit Rate / Floor / Ceiling.
testCases.expected: Rate fields accept up to 4 decimals (XX.XXXX%); 5th decimal rejected/truncated; Floor <= Ceiling and Base > 0 enforced.

testCases.precondition: On PL Pricing Matrix Step 1 with rate fields visible.
testCases.steps: Inspect Processing Fees dropdown (Fee/Percentage) and its 4-decimal input; inspect Early Settlement and Deferred Payment Per Year.
testCases.expected: Processing Fees lists Fee/Percentage with 4-decimal input; Early Settlement and Deferred Payment Per Year (new vs Core-ML) present, mandatory, numeric up to 4 decimals (XX.XXXX).

testCases.steps: Inspect the available Product Scheme Factors and their values.
testCases.expected: Exposes Transaction Type, Minimum Salary/Salary Slab, Employment Type (Company Employee/Self Employed/Pensioner), Residency Type (Local/GCC Countries/Expat), STL (Yes/No), Company Type (ALOC/Non-ALOC); Property Status/Location factors NOT present.

testCases.steps: Generate the matrix and inspect the file name; upload a file including Early Settlement and Deferred Payment Per Year columns with invalid values.
testCases.expected: Template named 'PL_Pricing Offers Template_ddmmyyyyhhmmss.xlsx'; upload validates all columns incl. new ones (numeric, 4 decimals, > 0); invalid rows -> error-annotated Excel + ET33 email to creator.

testCases.precondition: A PL pricing offer file uploaded successfully; prior ACTIVE same-name scheme exists.
testCases.expected: Scheme DRAFT -> ACTIVE; prior ACTIVE same-name scheme -> INACTIVE; duplicate factor combinations rejected with validation error.

testCases.precondition: Users with and without EDITOR permission for PL Product Setup.
testCases.steps: Verify Add Product button visibility and Personal Loan tab visibility per permission/config.
testCases.expected: Add Product requires EDITOR permission (Product Type = Personal Loan); PL tab shows only when PL enabled in User Management > Product Type; Role Management labels type 'Personal Loan'.
